title: Pad see ew
intro: Pad see ew is a Thai stir-fried noodle dish made with wide rice noodles, dark soy sauce and Chinese broccoli, cooked in a hot wok until the noodles pick up a light char at the edges. It sits alongside pad thai as one of Thailand's most popular noodle dishes, known for its deep, slightly smoky soy flavour rather than a sour or spicy one.
